profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. is a public company, traded as DDOG, that describes itself as offering cloud monitoring as a service. According to its website, the product collects metrics from all of a customer's apps, tools and services in one place, and a free trial is offered. The company is headquartered in New York, NY, and its SEC Central Index Key is 0001561550.

The site also frames the company around security as well as monitoring. It describes integrating security and observability so that organizations can decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response with agentic speed against AI-powered attacks. That is the company's own characterization of its position rather than a neutral description.

The record holds no lawsuits and no MCP servers for the company, and no individual products are tracked. Its legal exposure is recorded in New York, with 458 entries.
